title: Support reactions
assumptions: Supports are ideal: A is a pin and B is a roller.
Positive y is upward and counterclockwise moments are positive.

explanation.text: No external horizontal load is applied, so the horizontal pin reaction is zero.
Taking moments about A eliminates $A_x$ and $A_y$, because their lines of action pass through point A.
After $B_y$ is known, vertical force equilibrium gives the remaining vertical reaction at A.
